title: Surreal Oracle Portrait
description: A detailed line art portrait of a woman with heterochromia occupies the right side of the image, her face partially covered in intricate geometric patterns in green, purple, and black. To the left is a vast fantasy landscape featuring blue arched bridges, tiered towers with blue domes, terraced purple fields, a white horse, and a large red celestial body in the pale sky.
prompt: Intricate surreal fantasy illustration showing a close-up portrait of a mysterious woman with one purple eye and one golden eye, her face and head covering adorned with complex geometric triangular patterns in green, purple and black. She has a circular emblem on her forehead depicting a small figure. Beside her is an expansive dreamlike landscape with blue arched viaducts and bridges, tiered circular towers with blue domes, terraced purple hills, a white horse, and a large textured red celestial body floating in the pale sky, detailed black and white linework with selective coloring.
medium: digital line art with selective color
